The '''''Screaming Jawas''''' was a [[Band/Legends|band]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]]. They were known to play in the [[Arcade Omicron]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="DH" /> Their music was described as a "terrifying screech of sound and synthesized thunder".<ref name="News">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
